name: TES 01A · Airbnb booking confirmed → ask Meet for guest contact

filters.q: from:(airbnb.com) subject:("Reservation confirmed" OR "Booking confirmed") newer_than:2d

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO airsynk.bookings (confirmation_code, guest_first_name, listing_name, listing_code, check_in, check_out, guests, payout_inr, source_email_id, status)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, NULLIF($4, ''), NULLIF($5, '')::date, NULLIF($6, '')::date, NULLIF($7, '')::int, NULLIF($8, '')::numeric, $9, 'awaiting_guest_contact')
ON CONFLICT (confirmation_code) DO UPDATE SET updated_at = now()
RETURNING *, (xmax = 0) AS is_new;
